title: 2026 Minnesota Election Results
description:
This file contains elections results from the 2026 Minnesota General Election Results. The results are at the voting precinct level, and include the following races; Minnesota Governor & Lieutenant Governor, U.S. MN Senate, U.S. MN Representative, Minnesota Legislative House & Senate.

You can filter the results by using definition query on the UNIT attribute field (cng = Congressional District, cty = county, hse = House District, sen = Senate District, vtd = voting precinct) to get the intended geographic base layer.
snippet: This dataset shows the elections results from the 2026 Minnesota General Election Results.
accessInformation: Original results & data was downloaded from Office of the Minnesota Secretary of State.
